name: 48164 · New Boston, MI
findings: ZIP 48164 (New Boston) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48164 (New Boston) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48164 (New Boston) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
